text:
deploy-bot: Starting changewindow deploy for release v2.14.0 — canary -> 10% traffic (us-west-2). Observability probes enabled. Watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, embeddings route.
alex: ack — linking release notes https://confluence.company/releases/v2.14.0 :rocket:
sam: grabbing dashboards now — grafana snapshot https://grafana.company/d/abcd1234/canary-overview
sam: quick numbers: p95=118ms (baseline 110), p99=420ms, 5xx=0.15% (up from 0.04% over last 10m)
nora: seeing a cluster of traces with error=UpstreamTimeout on embed workers around 13:02 UTC
teresa: suggests temporarily throttling /v1/embeddings to fallback-model if possible to soak load
mike: if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> rollback. Otherwise prefer pin and hold.
alex: agree. Rollback criteria: p95 delta >50% OR 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m. Pin+hold if borderline.
sam: running quick PromQL to verify 5xx trend:
```promql
sum(increase(http_server_responses_total{status=~"5..",route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m])) by (route)
```
sam: query shows 5xx count x3 in last 7m for embeddings route
deploy-bot: Manual override: canary traffic set to 8% (actor alex)
teresa: applying model-pin for embeddings to v2.13.9: `/ops/pin --route /v1/embeddings --version v2.13.9`
alex: applied pin, verifying pins: `/ops/check-pins` -> embeddings: v2.13.9 (pinned), global: v2.14.0
nora: traces look nicer after pin, fewer upstream timeouts visible in flamegraph
sam: metrics after pin: p95=116ms, 5xx=0.08% — falling toward baseline
mike: ok to hold and monitor. Recommend hold for 10m, then ramp to 30% if stable
alex: placing a manual hold for +10m and updating release notes with a short incident note if we keep the pin. I’ll update the changelog.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 8% per manual hold (actor alex) — monitoring continues :hourglass_flowing_sand:
teresa: added QA note and pin rationale to doc https://confluence.company/pages/v2.14.0-canary-notes
alex: will re-evaluate at +10m. Thanks for quick reactions everyone.
deploy-bot: last automated check at 6891234590 — p95=115ms, 5xx=0.07% — no rollback triggered.
